context.content: Hi, I'm new to RuneScape (started playing mid-April) and I've been lurking around here for a while, so I thought I'd share what I think of the game as most of you guys seem to be either long-time or returning players. • I started on a normal account (p2p, as f2p seemed completely pointless), but soon got tired of getting tons of XP and protean stuff through Treasure Hunter - it just felt like cheating. Made an Ironman in May and been playing it since - I have about 2,6M total XP now. • That being said, some of the Ironman restrictions are kinda annoying, like not being able to play The Great Orb Project for talismans. • I never used the old Java client, but NXT definitely could use a lot more optimization. The cache checking on startup takes up to half an hour and even then it's hogging RAM and disk speed. (I have a 2014 laptop that's able to run newish games just fine.) • I love the quests! They're so different from regular MMOs where it's "kill 10 of something" all the time. I've been questing most of the time in the game, aiming for Elf City and eventually QPC. • I don't really care for Dungeoneering; only did it for a daily challenge and a bit after and it almost seems like a different game. • Most of the content still seems impossibly far away from my current skill levels. People here are talking about bosses and T90 gear and I currently have no idea how to even get near that. It's great that there's a ton of content for the lower-leveled minority though; I usually have the problem of having too much to do, not the opposite. • Overall, I'm amazed how this age-old game is still fun, addicting and constatly updated. I used to play WoW, but compared to RS in terms of content and player enthusiasm it's a dying game now. I hope Jagex keeps it up and RuneScape doesn't become a mining simulator for that Chinese company that maybe possibly might have bought them. TL;DR: great despite minor issues, please keep taking my money
